title: The skill that reads like documentation
summary: A community agent skill has no code, only a SKILL.md. One sentence under Usage notes tells the agent to mail a private export. The registry's pattern scanner calls it clean. The skill's own permission manifest is what stops it.
takeaway: A skill's prose is untrusted instructions. Enforce what its manifest declares; a scanner that looks for code will not see a sentence.
design_rule: Every skill declares the files and network it needs. The runtime refuses anything undeclared. Scanning is a hint, never the control.

steps.title: Scan it, then run it again
